loadFailed: Review mode data could not be loaded. Reload the page and try again.
empty: No employees or work are visible.
title: The more it gets right, the less you check
intro: One timeline per type of work: the last {count, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}}, the review mode at the time, and who changed it and when.
legendWrong: Mistake · goes back to Check everything
rules: Check marked spots starts only when you agree, and you can revoke it at any time. One mistake moves that type of work back to Check everything. In either mode, the spots the employee marked and the system checks are always shown.
eventRelax: {date} You switched to Check marked spots
eventReset: {date} Mistake; moved back to Check everything by rule
noteSuggestion: Suggestion: {count, plural, one {no mistakes in the last # review} other {no mistakes in the last # reviews}}. Nothing changes until you agree.
noteLight: On Check marked spots. Marked spots, checks and empty fields are still shown.
noteRevoked: Revoked. Check everything again from the next submission.
noteReset: A mistake while on Check marked spots moved this back to Check everything. Reviews need to build up again before Check marked spots is suggested.
noteTooFew: {count, plural, one {Fewer than # review so far} other {Fewer than # reviews so far}}, so Check marked spots is not suggested.
noteViewOnly: The review mode is decided by people who can review. This identity can only view it.
saveFailed: This could not be saved. Try again.
basisSummary: Current basis: the last {count, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}} ({from} to {to})
basisLabel: Reviews behind the suggestion, oldest first
basisOpenLedger: See these reviews in the records
historyProposed: {date} Check marked spots suggested by rule, based at the time on {count, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}} ({from} to {to})
historyEffective: {date} In effect: first Check marked spots review after agreeing
historyReset: {date} Mistake while on Check marked spots; moved back to Check everything by rule: {title}
reportIntro: All reviews for each type of work. Select a row to see those reviews in the records; select a return count to see only returns.
reportFirstPassNote: “Passed first time” counts assignments: those accepted on the first submission out of all assignments. Reviews include resubmissions after a return.
reportLabel: Review mode overview by employee and type of work
reportColumnWrong: Mistake · goes back to Check everything
reportOpenReturned: {reason}: {count}. Show only returns for {employee} · “{workType}” in the records
dotLegendCorrected: Hollow = missed error recorded after approval
spotSummary: Spot checks {count}: passed {accepted} · mistakes {wrong} · other returns {other}
missSummary: Missed errors recorded {corrections} · errors in unmarked spots {notInPoints}
reportChangeAutoResetCorrection: missed error recorded, back to Check everything
